description:
## 1.0.0

Unlock lifetime for Tracket 0.9.38 (versionCode 237).

Seeds the on-device entitlement grant and skips the Play license check on a re-signed APK. This is a client-side patch. A server can still refuse the account.

If you like this app, please consider buying a subscription and supporting the developer. Plans: Monthly, Yearly, and Lifetime (`pro_lifetime`).
